title: Paul McCartney live: Forum Horsens Stadium, Horsens | 2004
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Forum Horsens Stadium in Horsens, Denmark, on 9 June 2004.

It was the eighth show of the 04 Summer Tour, which lasted for 14 dates between May and June 2004, and the second of two consecutive nights in Horsens.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
